author: Murphh
body:
Hey players!  We are team HOME looking for members.
https://avicus.net/teams/1160
https://avicus.net/teams/1260
Both of these are HOME ^
We have fun and scrim on the side!  For some reason, the team was disbanded yesterday, but I'd like to start it up again.  If you were a former member, I will invite you again.

Besides the occasional scrim, we build houses, have gapple PVP, practice TNT skills, etc...
